name: Stride Stop at Game Speed
setup: Ball in triple threat at the hip, feet a little wider than the hips, knees bent.
cues: Full game speed now: if your form slips, drop back to the slower version.
Dribble in, land one-two, the first foot becoming the pivot on the floor.
Keep the ball tight to the hip, away from the defender.

faults.fault: Travelling: the pivot foot slides
faults.fix: Glue the pivot foot to the floor and turn on the ball of it.

faults.fault: Standing tall out of the stance
faults.fix: Stay low and level through every step, like under a low ceiling.

faults.fault: Ball swinging loose away from the body
faults.fix: Rip the ball from hip to hip, tight and fast.
